text: 中国人民银行8月1日召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议强调，进一步提升金融管理和服务水平。推动重点立法修法项目。开展金融统计制度与标准框架设计，持续做好重点领域统计监测。提升现金、支付、国库、征信服务质效，进一步优化县域金融服务，强化对金融机构开展县域金融服务的指导和运行情况监测。深化科技管理与创新应用，健全金融业网络安全管理制度。做好第五轮反洗钱国际评估工作。统筹做好安全管理工作，切实做好防汛防灾工作，确保重要信息系统和金融基础设施安全平稳运行。
text_en: The People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference on Aug 1. The meeting emphasized further improving financial management and service standards. Key legislative and regulatory revision projects will be advanced. Financial statistics systems and standard framework design will be carried out, with continued statistical monitoring of key areas. Cash, payment, treasury, and credit reporting service quality will be enhanced, county-level financial services further optimized, and guidance and monitoring of financial institutions' county-level services strengthened. Technology management and innovative applications will be deepened, and cybersecurity management systems for the financial industry improved. The fifth round of international anti-money laundering evaluation will be completed. Safety management will be coordinated, with flood and disaster prevention efforts ensured to maintain secure and stable operation of key information systems and financial infrastructure.
